assumptions.description: Transport the SHIP-Trend sex-specific conditional age associations and marginal distribution anchors from northeastern Germany to the supplied target adults. This is unvalidated; assays, ancestry, selection, calendar time and clinical composition may differ.

Conditional reference locations at age49.5 and BMI27 calibrated by the fixed additive source-median rule in scenario alt2; see calibration.json. This is conditional on approximated source covariates and inherited residual law, not an identified source intercept.

The contemporaneous BMI coefficient is assumed to be +0.02 HbA1c percentage points per kg/m2, identical by sex and linear. Its value and sign are not inferred from Hoorn adjusted-for-glucose or DIRECT prospective coefficients. It is not established by the admitted evidence.

Use a shifted lognormal residual: scale 0.95 times (exp(0.5 Z)-1), Z standard normal. Median residual zero, individual variation right-skewed. Scale/shape are assumptions motivated by approximately 0.8 percentage-point whole-cohort IQR, not a fitted source residual distribution. No separate diabetes component is identified.

Add age and BMI effects to the sex-specific location, with sex-specific linear age slopes across 20-79. No unreported spline term is used. The conditional residual distribution is constant across age, sex and BMI. Unmodeled interactions/nonlinearities are unassessed, not empirically absent.
Superseded source-X scenario metadata for M11: see M11_source_X, M11_BMI, M11_dependence and source_plan.json. Original M10 artificial replay context is not used.

Identity task mapping: hba1c_pct is HbA1c in percent, age_years years, bmi_kg_m2 kg/m2, sex male/female. Published quartile convention is unreported and is approximated with linear type-7 sample quantiles. Assay and population equivalence remain unverified.

Seeds resample individual residuals only. Source coefficient SEs are retained as evidence but not sampled as independent parameter distributions. No calibrated model/transport uncertainty, causal interpretation or prediction intervals are claimed.

Reported sex-age-bin counts from whole SHIP-Trend n4420, replicated10fold, uniform integer age within each bin; exact n4402 pregnancy/missingHbA1c exclusion covariates unknown. Frozen source covariates use no target rows.
Open >=70 bin compressed to70-79 for inherited task support. Sampling age20-79 is not proof of source examination maximum. BMI clipped15-50 is numerical assumption, not published support.
Both sexes share a pooledBMI marginal matching Masuch quartiles24.5,27.5,31.0. Primary/alt1 asymmetric-normal quantile tails and alt2 log-BMI tails are assumed; no raw sex-specificBMI law identified.
Primary uses independence within sex; alt1/alt2 fixed Gaussian-copula latent rho+0.35, not a reported correlation. Actual source age-BMI dependence unknown.

Identity source/task variables and units; published quantile method unknown, replay uses type7 linear interpolation. Mean regression slopes as median-location shifts require additive invariant residual law.
Masuch2019,Volzke2015,Grossmann2024 share SHIP-Trend baseline participants. Grossmann pooled means/SD are context-only diagnostics; weighted VolzkeBMI is not fit. No independent replication.

Applied fixed source-only pooled-median offset to each sex location using scenario alt2 and all3source seeds. Only locations changed; no target information. Fitted source median agreement is mechanical, not independent validation.

reference_age.derivation: Assumed midpoint of task/source-supported integer age range 20-79.

reference_bmi.derivation: Assumed centering value; not an admitted source BMI statistic.

location_by_sex.derivation: Initial inherited location + published SHIP-Trend marginal median - pooled verified initial source median, scenario alt2, seeds94101/94102/94103; all inputs and signed offsets bound in calibration.json.

age_slope_by_sex.derivation: Reported BMI-adjusted sex-specific linear age effects 0.153 and 0.191 per decade divided by 10. SHIP-Trend strata have no spline term.

bmi_slope.derivation: Explicit assumed weak positive contemporaneous BMI relationship; no prohibited coefficient transfer.

residual_scale.derivation: Assumed residual scale; 0.8 marginal IQR motivates dispersion, with covariate spread also contributing.

residual_log_sd.derivation: Assumed lognormal shape parameter, fixed across individuals and seed draws.
